content_sections.heading: About Amrita
content_sections.text: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham is inviting applications for this post through its Kochi Campus. Its website lists locations at Amritapuri, Amaravati, Bengaluru, Chennai, Coimbatore, Kochi, Mysuru, Nagercoil, Faridabad and Haridwar. It describes its Amritapuri campus as a multi-disciplinary research and teaching institute.

content_sections.heading: Amrita Verbal and Communication Trainer Vacancy Details 2026
Amrita Verbal and Communication Trainer Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Post Graduation. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Verbal and Communication Trainer
content_sections.text: Train students in verbal and communication skills, covering vocabulary-building, grammar, syllogisms, critical reasoning and comprehension. Encourage and motivate students to communicate fluently and confidently. Prepare students for higher-study exams such as CAT and GRE, and train them in special skills like public speaking and debate. Conduct exams regularly and give immediate feedback, so students can rate their progress and identify weak areas. Give training based on industry requirements, so students can face placement tests. Be ready to imbibe new technology-based training. Identify students who lack communication skills and give them special training to overcome their limitations. Provide career counselling and guidance, and record the data in the required formats. Actively participate and contribute in the special training drives organised by CIR for Amrita students. Stay updated on university accreditation requirements under CIR's learning and development activities. Contribute to periodic curriculum revisions in verbal and communication skills, in line with current industry requirements. Keep students' knowledge current by sharing the latest question papers, vocabulary-building techniques and newly coined words through the Amrita University Management System (AUMS) software.

faq.question: Q1. Which subjects will the trainer cover?
faq.answer: The training covers vocabulary-building, grammar, syllogisms, critical reasoning and comprehension, along with special skills like public speaking and debate.

faq.question: Q2. Is this a teaching or a non-teaching post?
faq.answer: Amrita lists the post under the Non-Teaching job category, although the work involves training students directly.

faq.question: Q3. Which exams will students be prepared for?
faq.answer: The notice names CAT and GRE as examples of higher-study exams. The trainer also prepares students for placement tests.

faq.question: Q4. Does the job include career counselling?
faq.answer: Yes. The trainer provides career counselling and guidance to students and records the data in the required formats.

faq.question: Q5. Which software will the trainer use?
faq.answer: The trainer shares question papers, vocabulary-building techniques and newly coined words with students through the Amrita University Management System (AUMS) software.
